list: The official 55 trophies, as listed before the bounty opened (Exophase and PSNProfiles agreeing on every name, description and grade). Names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is our own advice written from the official description. The game released 19 November 2026, so steps that depend on a place or a mission detail we have not yet been able to check in the game are marked as not yet checked.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, then collectibles and the long grinds — and it will pop last. Keep the tracker on this page updated so you can see at a glance which trophies are still standing between you and it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. This is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it cannot be missed — just follow the mission as the game presents it. If you are replaying the story, it unlocks again on a fresh playthrough or through mission replay where the game offers it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are story progress, not a single trick, so play the missions in order and this pops when the chapter closes. Nothing in a chapter can be skipped past in a way that loses the trophy — the game awards it when the chapter is complete.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this is earned by playing the story through, so keep going mission by mission and it unlocks when the chapter ends. The name is printed here exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. This is the halfway marker of the story chapters, so by the time it pops you will also have a good share of the mission-specific trophies behind you. Keep the story moving and do not worry about side content yet — it waits for you after the credits.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. When this pops, the story is nearly done and only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy. Use the lull before the finale to pick up any side activity you passed on the way, since the open world stays open after the story ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the only gold story trophy and it marks the end of the campaign, so there is no shortcut: play every chapter first. The exact mission name and any choice it offers have not yet been checked in the game, so finish it however the story presents it and the trophy follows. After the credits, the world stays open for everything that remains.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one unlock by finishing the named mission, so follow its objectives as they appear. The mission's place in the story and its exact steps have not yet been checked in the game, so this guide stays at the official description until a checked playthrough confirms more.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in this series usually offer a setup phase first, so do any setup the game asks for and then run the heist itself. The exact setup steps have not yet been checked in the game, so follow the on-screen objectives and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. This is a story mission trophy, so it unlocks by finishing that mission as part of the campaign. No extra preparation is needed beyond playing the story in order; the mission's details have not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish the mission the way the game lays it out and the trophy pops at the end. The mission's objectives have not yet been checked in the game, so this guide does not invent a walkthrough for it — the official description is the reliable part, and the mission itself is unmissable story progress.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The name points at an airport job, so expect a vehicle or aircraft theft as the core of it. The exact objectives have not yet been checked in the game, so follow the mission markers and finish it to earn the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The title suggests a large set-piece mission, so go in with full health and ammo and follow the objectives as they come. Its exact steps have not yet been checked in the game, so this is a story-progress trophy: finish the mission and it is yours.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist, which the pause menu tracks. This is the second gold trophy and the long grind of the platinum: it needs the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities all finished, so treat it as the last-but-one goal. Check the in-game completion list regularly to see which category is holding you back, and save it for the cleanup stage of the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, as the game counts them. This is a grind best done passively: drive fast, take ramps and jump gaps whenever you travel, and the count climbs on its own. For a focused push, find a spot with a repeatable jump and loop it; the exact stunt list the game tracks has not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the game's activities include things like fishing, racing, the shooting range, bowling and the arcade, and PSN tracks 9 types. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just sample each one. Open the activities list in the pause menu to see which types you have not tried yet, then tick them off one by one.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands. Start with the challenges you are closest on, and save the hardest for last when your aim and weapon handling are at their best.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about smooth lines through the gates rather than raw speed, so learn each course's gate order before pushing hard. The 14 locations are spread across Leonida, and each one counts only when you win there — a second place does not count.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Only distinct races count, so winning the same race twice adds nothing — move on to a new race each time. Pick the vehicle class you handle best, learn the shortcuts on each course, and work through the race list across Leonida until 20 wins are banked.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are usually scored on the size or the total weight of the catch, so pick the best rod and bait you have and fish the spots the challenge points you to. Cal's exact challenge rules have not yet been checked in the game, so read the challenge prompt when it appears and fish to beat his score, not just to catch anything.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, not just start one. Pick the cabinet whose game you understand best, learn its controls in the first round, and play it through to the end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the easiest one you can find.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock as you meet people around Leonida, and each one ends with a final mission — follow Andy's missions in order until the last one is done. The strand's missions and their unlock conditions have not yet been checked in the game, so watch for Andy's marker on the map and take his missions as they appear.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. The name hints at a boat, so expect water in the finale, but the reliable advice is the same as for every stranger strand: meet Kenton, finish his missions in order, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. His missions have not yet been checked in the game, so no step is invented here.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. The name suggests a solo ride, so expect a bike or a long drive in the finale. As with the other stranger strands, the strand is found by meeting Billy out in the world and taking his missions as they appear, and the trophy comes with the final one.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as you explore, and each strand is a short chain of missions ending in a final one — several of those finals have their own trophies on this list. Work through them as you find them rather than hunting them all at once, and this silver pops when the eighth strand is finished.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. The name points at a supply job, so expect a delivery or a pickup run in the finale. Meet Randy, take his missions in order, and finish the last one — the trophy follows the strand, and the strand's details have not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. The name hints at a spin — a wheel, a turntable or a stunt — but the honest guide is the strand itself: find Tyrone, run his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks with the last one. His mission details have not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic places the game marks when you get close, so explore the map's quiet corners — beaches, hilltops and viewpoints — and meditate at each one. Keep a note of which spots you have done, since the count only moves when you find a new one.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting one: he will point you at a rare animal, and you need to track it and take it down. Bring a scoped weapon, move slowly so the animal does not bolt, and take the shot when it is clean. The animal's location has not yet been checked in the game, so follow Bret's directions when the strand opens.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and in shops, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time, and check your collection often to see which sets are one card away. The card locations have not yet been checked in the game, so this guide does not pin any card to a spot.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. This is the longest collectible grind on the list after the stunts, so treat it as background work: WAiNK It whenever you pass a new place instead of saving it for a cleanup run. The game's map and counter will show how many locations remain, and the exact list of locations has not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small side goals — driving, shooting, exploring and more — and they stack up naturally as you play everything else. Open the challenges list in the pause menu to see which ones are nearly done, then finish the easy ones first and leave the long ones for the cleanup stage.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. This is flagged missable because it needs your partner present, and partner missions are limited — do it the first time the game gives you a partner and a chance to run. Break line of sight, hide until the stars fade, and do not get caught while they are still falling.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the heat, not losing it. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and move fast between them so the wanted level never drops. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner, so try it whenever a partner mission gives you the opening.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts, so climb into anything you have not driven before — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the total. The variety of Leonida's traffic does most of the work if you keep switching rides instead of sticking to one favourite car.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when several are in view, and chain the takedowns before the focus ends. A busy mission shootout is the best place to try it, and you can retry the moment as often as a mission allows.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without following the airport's rules. This is flagged missable because airport access can be limited outside the mission that opens it, so attempt it the first time you are inside VCIA with a plane in reach. Get airborne fast and the trophy should pop as you leave.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tanks — the description jokes about how hot it gets inside them. The official description gives no count or place, so the honest guide is to engage with Rhinos when the game puts them in front of you, whether that means driving one or surviving one. The exact trigger has not yet been checked in the game, so do not trust any walkthrough that claims a precise step for it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is flagged missable because a botched attempt can lock the store down, so save first if the game allows it and plan the approach: enter quietly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt is over — back out and try again another time.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies of the open world: crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear before the law closes in. Plan an escape vehicle before you go in, and do the vaults one at a time rather than chaining them — each one counts only when you escape.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash. The escape is part of the trophy, so have a fast car ready and lose the wanted level before you relax.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state — the cities, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside. The pause menu shows which areas you have not visited yet, so use it to find the last few instead of wandering blind.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs hold territory across Leonida, and each gang's operation is a place to hit — find one per gang and rob it. The gang territories are marked by the world itself, so work through the map gang by gang and tick each one off as its operation falls.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or a beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is a quiet moment, not a mission. The exact bar or spot has not yet been checked in the game, so try the beachfront bars first and watch for the prompt.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass. Find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside or lined up at its window, and drive out through the glass. The exact showroom has not yet been checked in the game, so try the showrooms around Vice City first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish the game, not just one frame. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also helps Master of None. The alley's exact location has not yet been checked in the game, so look for it in Vice City and play a full game when you find it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is about a partnership with mass appeal — the official description gives no count, place or step, so no honest guide can name one yet. It most likely relates to Lucia and Jason's partnership and something the pair does together that the game tracks. Play the story with both characters and watch for a partnership moment; the trigger has not yet been checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count to 500 for this trophy, and the description points at choices made along the way. This is flagged missable because choices happen during missions and conversations, and a choice you never make cannot be counted later — so engage with every choice the game offers instead of rushing past dialogue. Work through the story making decisions whenever they appear, and the count climbs toward 500.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description says second time's the charm, so this is about failing something and then passing it on the retry. This is flagged missable only in the sense that it needs a failure first: do not fear failing a mission or a challenge, because the retry is what earns it. Play naturally, and when something goes wrong, try it again right away.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like a UFO or paranormal encounter, the kind of secret this series hides in the open world. Explore odd places at odd hours, especially the countryside and the Keys, and keep an eye out for anything that does not belong. The exact encounter has not yet been checked in the game, so this guide does not invent a location for it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. This is flagged missable only because it needs a moving target and the right moment, so try it on a quiet road with a pedestrian in reach: drive past slowly, swing, and keep moving. It may take a few passes before the game counts one.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean money over time — keep feeding them bills as you earn them and the total climbs. This is a slow earner, so start it early in the story and let it run in the background of everything else.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and property all count, so buy what you actually use and the total takes care of itself — do not throw money at junk just to hit the number. Late in the game, when money is plentiful, a big vehicle or property purchase can close the gap in one go.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the in-game property market, and each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good. Save up and buy them as they appear, since some may only unlock as the story opens new areas of Leonida.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the app and register each one — ten different vehicles, not the same one ten times. This pairs well with Whip It Good, since every vehicle you discover is a candidate for the app too.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list; PSN count: PSNProfiles; guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
